controls.title: Improper Offboarding
controls.description: Non-human identities not deactivated or removed when retired remain active beyond their intended use, leaving exploitable dormant credentials.

controls.title: Secret Leakage
controls.description: Credentials and secrets exposed in source code, logs, configuration files, or tool payloads significantly raise the risk of a severe breach.

controls.title: Vulnerable Third-Party NHI
controls.description: Third-party tools and integrations introduce non-human identities with excessive or unvalidated scope that can be inherited or abused.

controls.title: Insecure Authentication
controls.description: Weak, missing, or reusable authentication on machine-to-machine channels lets attackers impersonate or hijack non-human identities.

controls.title: Overprivileged NHI
controls.description: Non-human identities granted more permissions than required widen the blast radius when a credential is compromised or misused.

controls.title: Insecure Cloud Deployment Configurations
controls.description: Insecure storage and deployment configurations expose credentials in cleartext or leave non-human identities accessible to attackers.

controls.title: Long-Lived Secrets
controls.description: Long-lived tokens and credentials without expiry let a compromise persist far beyond a single session or task.

controls.title: Environment Isolation
controls.description: Failure to isolate environments lets production non-human identities be reused or exposed in lower-trust contexts.

controls.title: NHI Reuse
controls.description: Shared credentials reused across agents, tools, or services let one compromise impersonate or affect many others.

controls.title: Human Use of NHI
controls.description: Humans using machine or service-account credentials break per-principal attribution and accountability.
